summary: 3DMLoader imports Rhino .3dm models — parser black-boxed.
3MFLoader imports 3D Manufacturing Format models (optionally with materials) — parser black-boxed.
Multi-pass advanced post stack (bloom, DOF, etc. combinations) demonstrating pass ordering discipline.
AmbientLight and/or HemisphereLight provide non-directional fill so PBR materials are not pure black in shadow.
Drives per-frame updates via renderer.setAnimationLoop (preferred) or an equivalent rAF loop, updating timers/stats before render.
AnimationMixer advances glTF (or other) AnimationClips on a rooted Object3D each frame using a time delta.
AsciiEffect (or similar) remaps the rendered frame into an ASCII character grid for a stylized overlay.
Batched LOD with BVH accelerates rendering/selection of many detailed assets by picking LOD and spatial queries.
BatchedMesh radix/sort helpers reorder draws for better GPU coherency with BVH/LOD batches.
BlurredEnvironmentMapGenerator softens env maps for path-tracer / diffuse IBL look.
GPGPU boids with separation/alignment/cohesion shader passes updating bird velocity/position textures.
Authoring or updating BufferGeometry attributes (position, color, etc.) on the CPU for custom meshes or particle systems.
geometry.drawRange limits which indexed/non-indexed vertices are issued, enabling progressive reveal or culling.
Instanced billboards combine InstancedMesh with camera-facing quad logic for dense sprite fields.
Line / LineSegments from BufferGeometry for wire overlays and path visualization.
Selective enabling of draw groups or attributes to show subsets of a buffer without rebuilding it.
BVH acceleration structures speed raycasting or LOD batching against dense meshes.
Camera array / multi-perspective setups sample a scene from a grid of viewpoints.
CameraHelper visualizes another camera’s frustum in the scene so projection extents are visible while editing or comparing views.
Groups cameras (and markers) under a THREE.Group so they share transform/orientation while remaining separately configurable.
Runtime switch between PerspectiveCamera and OrthographicCamera as the active view camera, usually from keyboard input.
preserveDrawingBuffer plus download hooks export a PNG frame from the canvas.
Local/global clipping planes cut geometry in the fragment stage for sectional views.
ColladaLoader imports DAE scenes including kinematics/skinning demos — parser black-boxed.
Cascaded Shadow Maps split the view frustum into cascades for higher quality directional shadows over large ranges.
CubeTexture / cube render targets provide environment reflections and skyboxes.
Rendering into cubemap mip chains for filtered specular reflections.
Flow/curve modifiers instance or deform geometry along a curve path.
Attaches a DepthTexture to a render target so depth can be sampled in a later pass or material.
DRACOLoader decodes Draco-compressed mesh buffers; usually attached to GLTFLoader — decoder internals black-boxed.
Render-to-cubemap each frame (or on demand) for dynamic reflections of a moving scene.
EdgeSplitModifier duplicates vertices along sharp edges to preserve hard normals.
EffectComposer owns an ordered list of post-processing passes that replace direct renderer.render for the final image.
Browser import map remaps the `three` and `three/addons/` package names to local module URLs so examples run without a bundler.
EXRLoader loads OpenEXR environments for HDR IBL — decoder black-boxed.
FBXLoader imports Autodesk FBX meshes/animations into an Object3D hierarchy — parser black-boxed.
FirstPersonControls / PointerLock-style navigation moves the camera through the scene like a FPS view.
Scene.fog (Fog / FogExp2) fades distant objects into a fog color for depth cueing.
FontLoader + TextGeometry (or stroke text) builds extruded/shaped text meshes from typeface JSON.
Renders 3D Gaussian splat assets as a specialized volumetric/point representation (WebGPU sample path).
SPLATLoader / SPZLoader ingest Gaussian splat assets — decoder internals black-boxed.
Per-frame splat depth sort (splats.updateSort) keeps volumetric Gaussians ordered for blending.
Per-vertex colors on BufferGeometry drive Mesh materials with vertexColors enabled.
Geometry modifier utilities (simplifier, edge split, curve extrusion) transform BufferGeometry before mesh creation.
Shape / ExtrudeGeometry / parametric shapes build solid meshes from 2D contours.
GLTFLoader asynchronously loads a glTF/GLB asset and returns a scene graph (and optional animations) for display — parser internals black-boxed.
GPU Computation Renderer or WebGPU compute pipelines update particle/state textures each frame for birds, fluids, or rasterization.
GPU picking renders object IDs to an offscreen target for precise selection without CPU raycasts.
HDRLoader / RGBE-style loaders import HDR environments for PMREM and background.
AxesHelper, GridHelper, PolarGridHelper, BoxHelper, etc. visualize scene structure during authoring.
Hierarchical Z-buffer occlusion culling skips invisible clusters before compute/draw.
three.js Inspector overlay for runtime scene/material debugging in newer examples.
InstancedMesh draws many copies of one geometry/material with per-instance matrices (and optional colors) in few draw calls.
Pointer-driven edits to BufferGeometry attributes (paint, extrude, or select regions).
LDrawLoader imports LEGO-style LDraw models — parser black-boxed.
LightProbe provides diffuse irradiance from an environment for image-based lighting without full specular IBL.
HemisphereLight blends sky/ground colors for outdoor-style ambient fill.
RectAreaLight simulates area lighting from a rectangular emitter (needs uniform lib init).
SpotLight with angle, penumbra, and optional maps creates focused conical illumination.
lil-gui binds a plain params object to on-screen sliders/folders that write into materials, passes, or renderer settings at runtime.
Enables logarithmic depth buffer on the renderer to improve depth precision across large near/far ranges.
Marching cubes extract an isosurface mesh from a scalar field for metaballs/volumetric shapes.
Built-in materials MeshBasic/Phong/Standard/Lambert cover unlit and lit shading without custom shaders.
Bump and normal maps perturb shading normals for fine surface detail without extra triangles.
Channel visualization materials isolate albedo/metalness/roughness/normals for debugging PBR maps.
MeshPhysicalMaterial clearcoat layer adds a secondary specular coat for car-paint-like surfaces.
MeshPhysicalMaterial transmission/ior/thickness enable refractive glass-like materials.
Subsurface scattering materials approximate light bleeding through translucent surfaces.
MeshToonMaterial with gradient maps produces cel-shaded lighting bands.
Wireframe rendering via material.wireframe or dedicated edge geometries for mesh structure views.
Meshopt clusterizer/simplifier builds meshlet LODs for compute rasterization pipelines.
meshopt simplifyGeometriesByErrorLOD builds error-bounded LOD chains for batched meshes.
Reflector / refractive meshes render the scene into a texture for planar mirrors or refraction.
Morph target influences blend between geometry targets for facial/body shape animation.
Enables scissor test and sets viewport/scissor rectangles so multiple cameras can render into different screen regions in one frame.
Multiple Camera instances render the same scene into distinct viewports (array/stereo-like layouts).
Multisample render targets / MSAA resolve improve edge quality before post-process or present.
TSL/node materials build GPU graphs for WebGPURenderer materials and compute-adjacent shading.
Oriented bounding box helpers/tests for collision or picking against rotated volumes.
OBJLoader imports Wavefront OBJ geometry into a Group — parser black-boxed.
Ocean/water shader with animated normals, reflections, and optionally refraction.
OrbitControls orbits/pans/zooms a camera around a target using pointer input on the renderer canvas.
Quaternion/Euler/matrix orientation utilities demonstrate stable object aiming and frame transforms.
OrthographicCamera with left/right/top/bottom/near/far defines a parallel projection frustum (no perspective foreshortening).
Sets renderer.outputColorSpace (e.g. SRGBColorSpace) so textures and tone-mapped results display with correct encoding.
OutputPass performs final color-space/tone-mapping friendly output inside an EffectComposer stack.
WebGLPathTracer (addon) progressively path-traces the scene for offline-quality lighting at interactive accumulate rates.
PCDLoader imports point-cloud data sets as Points — parser black-boxed.
PDBLoader imports protein data bank structures for molecular visualization — parser black-boxed.
PerspectiveCamera instances define the overview camera and the toggled perspective view with animated fov/far tied to subject distance.
Physically based lights (Point/Spot/RectArea/Directional with intensity in physical units) illuminate MeshStandard/Physical materials.
PMREMGenerator converts equirectangular or cube env maps into a prefiltered mipmapped radiance environment for PBR reflections.
Pointer position injected as a predator force into a GPGPU flocking simulation.
Renders BufferGeometry vertices as Points with PointsMaterial (size, color, optional map) for particle/sprite clouds.
Portal rendering uses stencil or layered cameras so a surface shows another viewpoint/scene.
MaskPass / ClearMaskPass restrict subsequent composer passes to stencil-marked regions.
Pixelation pass downsamples then upsamples color to a blocky pixel-art look.
Sobel operator pass emphasizes edges from the color (or depth) buffer.
Screen-space reflections approximate glossy reflections from the depth/normal/color buffers.
Progressive lightmap / shadow accumulation softens shadows over frames instead of a single hard shadow map sample.
Procedural or randomized UV assignment for texture variation without unique assets.
Raycaster converts pointer NDC into world rays to pick meshes, points, or GPU-picked IDs for interaction.
Refraction mapping / transmission pipelines show background through transparent meshes.
RenderPass draws the scene into the composer’s read/write buffers as the first post-process stage.
On window resize, updates renderer size (and composer size if present) and camera aspect/projection so the image stays undistorted.
Reversed-Z depth buffer configuration improves precision for distant geometry when supported.
RoomEnvironment addon supplies a studio lighting environment map for quick PBR previews.
Nested wireframe SphereGeometry meshes and a point cloud provide a moving subject and depth cues for the camera demo.
Interactive mesh sculpting deforms vertex buffers from pointer strokes.
Object3D.layers / light layers restrict which lights affect which meshes for selective lighting setups.
ShaderMaterial / RawShaderMaterial with custom vertex/fragment shaders and uniforms for effects not covered by built-ins.
Enables shadowMap on the renderer and cast/receive on lights/meshes so depth maps produce shadows.
SimplifyModifier reduces triangle count while attempting to preserve shape.
Interactive spline/curve editing with control points that rebuild tube or line geometry.
Stats.js panel shows frame time / FPS for performance feedback during development.
Uses stencil buffer writes/tests with clipping to create portal-like or capped sectional rendering.
StorageBufferAttribute / IndirectStorageBufferAttribute drive indirect draws and atomics in WebGPU compute rasterizers.
SunLight helper/addon configures a distant sun-like directional light with related sky parameters.
SVGLoader parses SVG paths into shapes/strokes for extrusion or line rendering — parser black-boxed.
TDSLoader imports 3DS Max .3ds models — parser black-boxed.
TeapotGeometry addon provides the classic Utah teapot parametric mesh for material tests.
TextureLoader / specialized loaders fetch image textures and apply colorSpace, wrapping, and filtering for materials.
THREE.Timer (or Clock) supplies frame delta/elapsed time for animation mixers and simulations.
ACESFilmicToneMapping plus exposure (driven by a perceptual Math.pow slider) map HDR bloom results into displayable LDR.
TrackballControls provide free camera orientation without a fixed up-axis orbit pole.
TransformControls gizmo edits object position/rotation/scale with pointer dragging.
Scene.fogNode / rangeFogFactor style TSL fog instead of classic Fog alone.
TSL vertex displacement driven by light distances / effector fields for deformable meshes under WebGPU.
UltraHDRLoader loads Ultra HDR stills for high-dynamic-range texture display.
UnrealBloomPass extracts bright regions above threshold and blurs them with strength/radius controls exposed in lil-gui.
Raymarched or sliced volume rendering of 3D textures (perlin / instanced volume samples).
Antialiased WebGLRenderer provides the canvas; tone mapping is set on the renderer while presentation goes through the composer.
WebGPU.isAvailable (or equivalent) gates the demo before constructing WebGPURenderer.
WebGPU compute shaders update particle or fluid state buffers then draw the results.
Software/compute rasterizer path on WebGPU (including IBL variants) for experimental pipelines.
Interactive cubemap intensity/orientation adjustments under WebGPU environment lighting.
Height-based or custom fog implemented in WebGPU/TSL rather than classic Scene.fog alone.
Per-instance uniforms/storage in WebGPU instancing for varying material parameters cheaply.
Point light shading path exercised under WebGPURenderer (important reference for studio lighting).
Selective lighting under WebGPU using layers or per-object light lists.
Creates a WebGPURenderer (often after a capability check) and presents frames through the WebGPU backend instead of WebGL.
WebGPU shadow mapping with opacity/transparency considerations for shadowed transparent surfaces.
